title: Inheritance and Alibi
author: Jonah Whitlock
blurb: Bram Dravenmoor, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
